title: Add a Chinese book reader module with text-to-speech playback for Chinese sentences

requirements.text: Add backend support for storing “book-based” Chinese reading content as structured data (e.g., books/lessons with ordered Chinese sentences) and expose query + mutation methods to: (1) list available books/lessons, (2) fetch a single book/lesson with its sentences in order, and (3) create/update/delete books/lessons and sentences.

quotes: Créer moi une application a partir de ce livre, avec voix qui lis la phrase chinoise.

acceptanceCriteria: Backend defines stable Motoko types for book/lesson and sentence entries, including deterministic ordering (e.g., an explicit index/order field).
Backend provides canister methods to list books/lessons and fetch a selected one with its sentences.
Backend provides canister methods to create/update/delete books/lessons and sentences.
All methods are integrated into the existing single-actor architecture in backend/main.mo without introducing additional backend services.

requirements.text: Add React Query hooks for the new backend book/lesson and sentence APIs (list, get details, create/update/delete) following the existing patterns in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts, including cache invalidation for edits.

quotes: Créer moi une application a partir de ce livre, avec voix qui lis la phrase chinoise.

acceptanceCriteria: New hooks exist for listing books/lessons, fetching a selected book/lesson, and mutating content.
Mutations invalidate/refetch the correct queries so the UI updates immediately after edits.
Hooks handle the ‘actor not available’ state consistently with existing hooks.

requirements.text: Add a new ‘Book Reader’ area to the app UI with routing and navigation entry, without breaking existing pages. Include: (1) a library/list page to select a book/lesson, and (2) a reader page that displays the ordered Chinese sentences for the selected content.

quotes: Créer moi une application a partir de ce livre, avec voix qui lis la phrase chinoise.

acceptanceCriteria: A new navigation item is visible in the main layout and leads to the new book reader pages.
Users can see a list of available books/lessons and open one.
The reader view renders the Chinese sentences in the correct order and remains usable on mobile screens.

requirements.text: Implement in-browser text-to-speech playback for each Chinese sentence in the reader page using the Web Speech API (speechSynthesis). Provide per-sentence controls: Play, Stop, and an option to autoplay the next sentence. Set the utterance language to Chinese (e.g., 'zh-CN') and expose basic controls for rate and pitch.

quotes: ...avec voix qui lis la phrase chinoise.

acceptanceCriteria: Each sentence row has a Play control that reads the Chinese text aloud.
Stop immediately cancels current playback.
When Autoplay is enabled, finishing one sentence automatically starts the next sentence.
Speech uses a Chinese language tag (e.g., 'zh-CN') and the UI offers rate and pitch controls that affect playback.
If speechSynthesis is unavailable, the UI shows a clear fallback message and does not crash.

requirements.text: Add a simple content editor UI to allow entering the book content from the user’s book: create/edit a book/lesson and add/edit/reorder Chinese sentences. This editor must use the backend CRUD APIs (not hardcoded seed-only content).

quotes: Créer moi une application a partir de ce livre...

acceptanceCriteria: Users can create a new book/lesson with a title.
Users can add, edit, delete, and reorder sentences for a book/lesson.
Changes persist after refresh and are visible in the library and reader views.
Editor provides basic validation (non-empty title; non-empty Chinese sentence).

requirements.text: Apply a cohesive visual theme appropriate for a reading app (e.g., warm paper-like background, high-contrast typography, subtle ink accents) and enforce it consistently across the new Book Reader pages while still fitting the existing Tailwind/shadcn styling system.
acceptanceCriteria: Book Reader pages have a consistent, readable visual style (spacing, typography, colors) suitable for long text reading.
UI remains accessible (readable contrast, clear focus states) and responsive on mobile and desktop.

requirements.text: Add generated static image assets for the Book Reader module and render them from frontend/public/assets/generated (do not serve images through the backend).
acceptanceCriteria: The new generated image(s) exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced directly by the new UI.
Assets load correctly in the web build without backend involvement.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or anything inside frontend/src/components/ui; compose these components instead.
Keep all Motoko logic in the single actor at backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo changes if persistent state layout changes require a migration.
Do not break or remove existing routes/pages (Members, Financial, Programs, Groups, Attendance); the Book Reader must be added alongside existing functionality.
nonGoals: Do not integrate external text-to-speech providers or AI services; use only in-browser speechSynthesis for voice.
Do not implement OCR, PDF scanning, or automatic extraction of book content from images; content entry/import is manual via the editor UI.
Do not add real-time collaboration or WebSocket-based synchronized reading.

required: Book cover illustration in a minimalist ink-on-paper style with Chinese calligraphy-like strokes and a subtle bamboo motif (book-cover.dim_1200x1600.png)
